sn46.26:1.1: Yo bhikkhave maggo yā paṭipadā taṇhakkhayāya saṃvattati || tam maggaṃ tam paṭipadam bhāvetha || || 3.
sn46.26:1.2: Katamo ca bhikkhave maggo katamā ca paṭipadā taṇhakkhayāya saṃvattati ||
sn46.26:1.7: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Udāyi Bhagavantam etad avoca ||
sn46.26:1.8: Katham bhāvitā nu kho bhante satta bojjhaṅgā katham bahulīkatā taṇhakkhayāya saṃvattantīti || || 5.
sn46.26:2.1: Idha Udāyi bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossagaparināmiṃ vipulaṃ mahaggatam appamāṇam abyāpajjhaṃ ||
sn46.26:2.2: tassa satisambojjhaṅgam bhāvayato viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇamiṃ vipulam mahaggatam appamāṇam abyāpajjhaṃ taṇhā pahīyati || ||
sn46.26:2.5: Upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitam vossaggapariṇāmim vipulam mahaggatam appamāṇam abyāpajjhaṃ ||
sn46.26:2.6: tassa upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāvayato viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ vipulam mahaggatam appamāṇam abyāpajjhaṃ taṇhā pahīyati ||
sn46.26:2.9: Iti kho Udāyi taṇhakkhayā kammakkhayo kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo
